Subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance requirements (MedSys Health)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about the MedSys analytics roadmap and the key constraints around PHI in your inference pipeline. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security & data-handling milestone we discussed.

Post-call recap (short):
- Goal: Pilot Redwood Inference for MedSys patient-facing summarization, with strict PHI controls.
- Key MAP milestone for week-of security signoff: Data handling & compliance (retention, logging, audit trails, PHI/PII constraints).
- Next steps: update MAP with responsibilities, target close date, and dependencies; schedule technical follow-up with our infra/security SRE.

Draft MAP highlights (Data handling milestone):
1) Deliverables (Redwood):
   - Provide SOC 2 Type II report and security evidence bundle (config, logging capabilities).
   - Documented retention & log policies for inference requests and KV cache (default retention 30d; configurable per-customer).
   - Audit trail support: request-level logging, user/tenant IDs, timestamped event logs, and exportable audit reports.
   - KMS/HSM support for customer-managed keys in Private deployments; key rotation guidance.

2) Actions (MedSys):
   - Confirm whether PHI will be processed in-hosted vs private deployment. If private, provide VPC/infra contacts and firewall/peering windows.
   - Complete security questionnaire and share any required BAA/contract language.

3) Responsibilities & owners:
   - Redwood (security): provide evidence and host technical review. (Owner: Dylan Brooks)
   - MedSys (security/IT): confirm retention/archival requirements and BAA request. (Owner: Alice Zhang / Tom Reynolds)

4) Target close date: 2026-03-31 (subject to legal review and questionnaire completion).

5) Dependencies:
   - Completed security questionnaire & SOC 2 evidence review.
   - Legal/BAA execution if PHI processing is confirmed.
   - Technical call to validate logging/retention behavior against MedSys requirements.

Can you confirm the MedSys security contact(s) we should loop into the MAP and whether the 2026-03-31 target date works on your end? I attached the MAP draft for quick edits.

Attachments: 20260310-MAP-draft-MedSys.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP — this is helpful. A few clarifications/questions from the MedSys info-security side:

1) Security contact: please loop in Tom Reynolds (cc'ed) — he owns infra/security for our analytics team.
2) PHI/BAA: MedSys will be processing PHI in the pilot. We will need Redwood to sign a BAA. Is that supported for hosted or do you require a private deployment for BAA scope?
3) Retention: our compliance baseline is 30 days for request logs, and certain audit artifacts need to be retained for 7 years for regulatory audits. Can Redwood support configurable retention (30d default, archive to customer-managed storage for long-term)?
4) KMS/HSM: we require customer-managed keys for any long-term archival of PHI-derived artifacts. Do you support KMS/HSM and key rotation?

Also attaching our security questionnaire (MedSys-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx) — please have your security team fill sections relevant to the data-handling milestone.

One more ask: can we move the MAP target close date to 2026-03-31? That will align with our internal review windows.

Best,

Hi Alice / Tom —

Appreciate the quick clarification. Confirming the items below and next steps:

- BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA. For PHI processing we typically recommend our Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for the initial pilot to meet network isolation and KMS requirements; hosted options can be discussed but will require narrow scoping and contractual language.
- Retention: Redwood supports configurable retention windows for request logs and audit exports. Default inference request logs are retained for 30 days; we can configure archival/export to customer-managed storage for longer retention (e.g., 7 years) as part of the MAP.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys (KMS integration) in Private deployments and can provide key rotation procedures and HSM integration guidance.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Security evidence handoff: Dylan will pick up the security questionnaire and provide SOC 2 artifacts + logging/retention docs by 2026-03-16.
2) Technical call: schedule a 60-min session with Dylan + our SRE and your infra team to validate logging/retention behavior (proposed window: 2026-03-12 / 2026-03-13).
3) Legal: I will loop in our legal contact for BAA language; please confirm MedSys legal owner so I can start the intake.
